product_name_specific: Vanishing Cream, Cocoa Butter & Honey extracts
risk_description: The product contains clobetasol propionate (measured value: 0,0062 % by weight). Clobetasol propionate is a corticosteroid that should be applied only if medically prescribed. Exposure to it could cause skin irritation and may lead to endocrine problems.
legal_provision: The product does not comply with the Cosmetic Products Regulation.
